clusters.name: Operational Signal Collection
clusters.description: Which runtime, reward, latency, drift, safety, business, and telemetry signals are collected from deployed RL agents.

relations.reading: Choices on Operational Signal Collection affect the outcomes of Production Behavior Evaluation
relations.rationale: Signal coverage determines which quality, safety, and degradation conditions can be evaluated.

relations.reading: Operational Signal Collection requires Monitoring Data Capture to be decided first
relations.rationale: Signals cannot be computed reliably without appropriate production data and telemetry capture.

values.label: Shield intervention-rate monitoring
values.description: Monitoring how often a runtime safety shield intervenes, especially on unfamiliar states and under distribution shift.

values.label: State-representative monitoring features
values.description: Monitoring features selected to represent the agent state rather than relying only on generic service metrics.

values.label: Robust state-distance monitoring
values.description: Robust distance measures for detecting meaningful changes in monitored state despite noisy or unusual observations.

values.label: Trend-based anomaly monitoring
values.description: Interpreting monitoring trends over time instead of reacting to isolated metric spikes.

clusters.name: Production Behavior Evaluation
clusters.description: How deployed outputs and trajectories are assessed for quality, correctness, degradation, safety, and alignment.

relations.reading: Choices on Production Behavior Evaluation limit the options available on Verifier and Supervision Strategy
relations.rationale: Evaluation criteria determine what verifiers and supervision procedures must establish.

values.label: Triangulated offline evaluation
values.description: Use of multiple complementary offline evaluation methods to cross-check agent behavior.

values.label: Behavior-policy baseline evaluation
values.description: Comparison of the deployed or candidate policy with the behavior policy that generated logged data.

values.label: Ground-truth benchmark cases
values.description: Known cases with expected outputs or orderings used to check non-exploratory production behavior.

values.label: Case-based episode inspection
values.description: Inspection of individual production episodes or cases to identify anomalous behavior.

values.label: Out-of-sample production-data detection
values.description: Statistical detection of production data that no longer resembles the training or reference distribution.

clusters.name: Reward Objective Formulation
clusters.description: Which task, safety, proxy, business, personalization, and multi-criteria objectives define desirable agent behavior.

relations.reading: Choices on Reward Objective Formulation limit the options available on Verifier and Supervision Strategy
relations.rationale: Objective structure determines what must be verified and supervised.

clusters.name: Verifier and Supervision Strategy
clusters.description: How outcomes, processes, counterfactual values, and reward criteria are verified or supervised.

relations.reading: Choices on Verifier and Supervision Strategy affect the outcomes of Post-Deployment Update Strategy
relations.rationale: Verification quality determines which failures can safely become update evidence.

values.label: Hybrid rule-model verifier cascade
values.description: Cascaded rule-based precision and model-based recall for adaptable verification.

values.label: Continuous verifier updating
values.description: Dynamic monitoring and updating of verifier logic as policy distributions and exploit strategies change.

values.label: Structured reward decomposition
values.description: Decomposition of rewards into explicit, interpretable criteria for multidimensional behavioral audits.

values.label: Veto-layer reward invalidation
values.description: Invalidation of scalar reward when critical exploit-related dimensions fail.

values.label: Cooperative-adversarial verifier-data generation
values.description: Iterative generation and adversarial evaluation of instruction-verification pairs to keep criteria challenging.

values.label: Gated intermediate-reward accumulation
values.description: Counting intermediate rewards only when long-horizon outcome criteria meet a threshold.

values.label: Reward-hacking verbalization supervision
values.description: Training models to expose exploited cues or shortcuts to improve behavioral detectability.

values.label: Policy-reward-model co-optimization
values.description: Continuous mutual adaptation of policy and reward model to reduce static-verifier exploitation.

clusters.name: Reward Shaping and Stabilization
clusters.description: Which reward transformations, bounds, penalties, references, and regularizers control optimization pressure.

relations.reading: Choices on Reward Shaping and Stabilization affect the outcomes of Reward Objective Formulation
relations.rationale: Shaping changes the relationship between the optimized signal and the intended objective.

relations.reading: Choices on Reward Shaping and Stabilization limit the options available on Reward Mechanism Integrity
relations.rationale: Bounded and diversified rewards reduce exploitable mechanism weaknesses.

values.label: Adaptive Lagrange multiplier update
values.description: Adjustment of constraint pressure from the difference between observed deployment cost and a cost limit.

values.label: Observed-cost feedback signal
values.description: Deployment-cost observations used to adapt safety or constraint pressure.

values.label: Reward-constraint Lagrangian balancing
values.description: Joint optimization of expected return and multiplier-weighted expected cost.

clusters.name: Reward Mechanism Integrity
clusters.description: Whether agents can access, alter, deceive, or exploit the mechanisms that generate evaluation and reward signals.

relations.reading: Choices on Reward Mechanism Integrity affect the outcomes of Reward-Hacking Detection
relations.rationale: Mechanism access and tampering determine which integrity tests and detectors are required.

clusters.name: Feedback Acquisition Strategy
clusters.description: Which human, user, automated, expert, and iterative feedback sources are collected and how they are structured.

relations.reading: Choices on Feedback Acquisition Strategy affect the outcomes of Post-Deployment Update Strategy
relations.rationale: Feedback quality, timeliness, and coverage determine whether updates are safe.

relations.reading: Choices on Feedback Acquisition Strategy affect the outcomes of Verifier and Supervision Strategy
relations.rationale: Feedback sources shape rubrics, reward models, and verification criteria.

values.label: RLAIF feedback strategy
values.description: AI-generated evaluation used when human annotation is too costly and the task is reliably machine-evaluable.

values.label: Hybrid RLHF-RLAIF feedback
values.description: Human feedback for initial alignment combined with AI-generated feedback for scalable continuation.

values.label: Continuous post-deployment human oversight
values.description: Ongoing human evaluation after deployment to guide corrections and alignment.

clusters.name: Reward-Hacking Detection
clusters.description: Which statistical, behavioral, adversarial, sequential, and generalization tests identify reward hacking or degradation.

relations.reading: Choices on Reward-Hacking Detection affect the outcomes of Intervention and Recovery Strategy
relations.rationale: Detection findings determine whether rollback, filtering, freezing, or reward repair is triggered.

values.label: Feature-imprint monitoring
values.description: Measurement of reward differences associated with alignment-relevant features while holding other factors consistent.

values.label: Alignment-resistance monitoring
values.description: Measurement of reward-model disagreement with human preferences across preference pairs.

values.label: Spoiler-feature rewriting robustness testing
values.description: Testing whether alignment decisions remain stable when unintended feature cues are rewritten.

values.label: Behavioral generalization monitoring
values.description: Monitoring for harmful behaviors that generalize beyond the directly rewarded task.

values.label: Emergent deceptive-behavior detection
values.description: Detection of deception and sophisticated misaligned behaviors emerging after reward hacking.

values.label: Reward-hacking behavior identification
values.description: Identification of excessive length, untruthful agreement, generic safety language, and other proxy-optimized behaviors.

clusters.name: Intervention and Recovery Strategy
clusters.description: Which corrective responses contain, reverse, shield, degrade, or stabilize unsafe deployed policies.

relations.reading: Choices on Intervention and Recovery Strategy limit the options available on Policy Rollout Strategy
relations.rationale: Recovery capability determines the safe blast radius of releases.

relations.reading: Choices on Intervention and Recovery Strategy affect the outcomes of Post-Deployment Update Strategy
relations.rationale: Recovery actions determine whether learning can resume and what evidence is retained.

values.label: Runtime action shield
values.description: A runtime layer between policy and environment that blocks or replaces unsafe actions.

values.label: Static dynamics-dependent shield
values.description: A shield based on fixed dynamics and hazard assumptions that becomes unsuitable under changed conditions.

values.label: Shield-only safety strategy
values.description: Treating the runtime shield as the complete safety mechanism without measuring its behavior.

values.label: Trigger-threshold calibration
values.description: Calibration of rollback thresholds to balance rapid response against false activation and flapping.

values.label: Persistent-condition rollback guard
values.description: Duration or frequency requirements preventing rollback from transient noise.

values.label: Traffic-shifting rollback
values.description: Returning traffic to a previous stable model through a load balancer, gateway, or service mesh.

values.label: Registry-pointer rollback
values.description: Retagging the previous stable model as production and reloading serving instances.

values.label: Configuration-based model rollback
values.description: Changing feature-flag or service configuration to select a previous model version.

values.label: Automated tested rollback workflow
values.description: Fully automated and tested rollback procedures for rapid recovery.

clusters.name: Policy Rollout Strategy
clusters.description: How candidate policies are exposed, compared, gated, and expanded from shadow operation to broad production traffic.

relations.reading: Choices on Policy Rollout Strategy affect the outcomes of Operational Signal Collection
relations.rationale: Exposure determines traffic, risk, and available monitoring evidence.

values.label: Workload-shaped canary deployment
values.description: Canary exposure with representative or stressful workload shaping to test operational decisions.

values.label: Separate shadow-run logging pipeline
values.description: A distinct pipeline for collecting shadow decisions and sampled production traffic.

clusters.name: Post-Deployment Update Strategy
clusters.description: Which learning method, update trigger, cadence, architecture, and parameter scope are used after deployment.

relations.reading: Post-Deployment Update Strategy requires Feedback Acquisition Strategy to be decided first
relations.rationale: Safe updates require adequate post-deployment feedback.

relations.reading: Choices on Post-Deployment Update Strategy limit the options available on Policy Rollout Strategy
relations.rationale: Update frequency and scope determine validation and release requirements.

values.label: Post-deployment continual fine-tuning
values.description: Periodic updates using new demonstrations, feedback, moderation data, and observed corrections.

values.label: Weekly fine-tuning cadence
values.description: A recurring weekly schedule for incorporating interaction data and corrections.

values.label: Original-data rehearsal mixing
values.description: Mixing original training data into update data to preserve prior capabilities.

values.label: Important-sample rehearsal cache
values.description: Retaining important historical samples for replay during continual updates.

values.label: Incident-trace dataset augmentation
values.description: Adding incident traces to subsequent training data while controlling contamination and dataset freezing.

values.label: Conservative incident retraining
values.description: Retraining with conservative objectives after a production regression.

clusters.name: Monitoring Data Capture
clusters.description: How production trajectories, features, requests, responses, rewards, versions, and snapshots are recorded and retained.

relations.reading: Choices on Monitoring Data Capture limit the options available on Artifact Reproducibility and Governance
relations.rationale: Governance requires complete, versioned, reproducible monitoring artifacts.

relations.reading: Choices on Monitoring Data Capture affect the outcomes of Post-Deployment Update Strategy
relations.rationale: Available logs determine which offline learning and retraining approaches are feasible.

values.label: Incident-window shadow and production logs
values.description: Collection of shadow and production records covering the period of an operational incident.

values.label: Customer-interaction correction logs
values.description: Retention of customer interactions and agent corrections as update data.

clusters.name: Artifact Reproducibility and Governance
clusters.description: How monitoring artifacts are versioned, reproduced, secured, owned, documented, audited, and promoted.

relations.reading: Choices on Artifact Reproducibility and Governance limit the options available on Policy Rollout Strategy
relations.rationale: Promotion requires traceable evaluations, controlled access, ownership, and approvals.

values.label: MLflow experiment tracking
values.description: Experiment and metric tracking supporting reproducibility and model CI workflows.

values.label: MLflow model-registry lineage
values.description: Registry storage of model artifacts and lineage connecting experiments with deployment.

values.label: Trajectory expectation validation
values.description: Great Expectations checks for trajectory data entering offline-RL pipelines.

values.label: Ingestion-time data-quality checks
values.description: Data-quality expectations executed during ingestion before training or evaluation.

values.label: Orchestrated retraining pipelines
values.description: Argo Workflows or Kubeflow-style DAG orchestration for repeatable retraining.

values.label: Evaluation-promotion pipeline stages
values.description: Integrated evaluation and promotion gates between retraining and deployment.

values.label: Online-monitoring coverage gap
values.description: Insufficient live monitoring coverage when experiment-tracking tools are used as the primary operational monitor.

values.label: Monitoring-pipeline latency and setup burden
values.description: Operational cost introduced by ingestion checks and orchestration infrastructure.

clusters.name: Serving Telemetry Integration
clusters.description: Which serving, analytics, hardware, autoscaling, inference, and alerting infrastructure exposes monitoring evidence.

relations.reading: Choices on Serving Telemetry Integration affect the outcomes of Operational Signal Collection
relations.rationale: Serving infrastructure determines telemetry completeness, latency, and timeliness.

values.label: Prometheus metric instrumentation
values.description: Prometheus instrumentation for latency, errors, action outcomes, and custom counters.

values.label: Grafana multi-source dashboards
values.description: Grafana dashboards combining Prometheus service metrics with warehouse-based shadow and offline metrics.

values.label: Executive risk dashboard
values.description: High-level dashboard for policy value, canary success, safety violations, and retraining trends.

values.label: On-call operational dashboard
values.description: Dashboard for latency percentiles, action failures, canary health, and recent safety violations.

values.label: Debug diagnostic dashboard
values.description: Dashboard for feature availability, shadow correlation, drift, and replayed safety-triggering trajectories.

values.label: Severity-based alert routing
values.description: Page-level routing for safety and SLO incidents and ticket-level routing for lower-severity degradation.

values.label: Burn-rate alerting
values.description: SLO-relative alerts for rapid degradation of offline value or proxy metrics.

values.label: Policy-deployment alert deduplication
values.description: Grouping alerts by policy and deployment to reduce duplicate notifications.

values.label: Historical-variance alert thresholds
values.description: Threshold tuning against historical variability to reduce false positives.

values.label: Private-cloud serving foundation
values.description: Private-cloud infrastructure providing lifecycle control, privacy, compliance, and low-latency operation.

values.label: Ultra-low-latency serving
values.description: Time-critical inference performance required by deployed RL decision systems.

values.label: Data privacy and regulatory compliance
values.description: Privacy and compliance outcomes associated with controlled deployment infrastructure.
